subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `pre-push` by the push hook, docgate shall read the hook's ref lines from stdin and, when every pushed ref is a deletion (an all-zeros local SHA), pass without running content checks, saying so; when any non-deletion ref is pushed — or stdin carries no parseable ref lines — it shall run the merge-base gate exactly as today.
rationale: a ref deletion carries no content to gate; everything else fails closed to the full gate (issue #65)
fit_criterion: fixtures: a deletion-only stdin exits 0 with the skip notice; a mixed push runs the gate; a content push keeps today's verdicts; empty or malformed stdin runs the gate; the shim stays delegate-only and bash-3.2-clean
